## Bannerlord CPU Optimizer v0.4.0

This release expands the validated TOR campaign optimization pass while preserving exact game behavior and automatic fallback.

### Added

- Exact-build-gated early-exit optimization for TOR map visibility settlement checks.
- Reference shadow comparisons before activation and periodic original-method audits afterward.
- Audited fixed race-ID lookup cache for TOR health and race classification paths.
- Final hit-point values are never cached.
- Exact-order manual loops replacing two allocation-heavy LINQ chains in TOR's weekly companion update.
- Deeper focused attribution for hero health, troop health, companion spawning, disabling, and unregistering.
- MCM controls for each new optimization and its validation thresholds.
- Benchmark and profiler reports now include the runtime state of every released optimization.

### Benchmark workflow

- Benchmark - Baseline disables every released optimizer patch.
- Benchmark - Optimized enables every released safe optimizer patch.
- Both modes still complete and write reports automatically at 200 campaign hours.

### Safety

- Exact TOR_Core MVID, signature, and IL fingerprints are required.
- Foreign Harmony owners cause the affected optimization to refuse activation.
- Validation mismatches disable the affected optimization and restore original TOR behavior.
- No campaign schedule, randomization, spawn logic, save data, AI cadence, or final combat statistic is cached or changed.
